caption:
The neon rain hisses against my skin, warm and electric. 💦 I lean against the rusted railing of the Sky-High Docks, the humid summer air thick with the scent of ozone and synthetic perfume. My custom-woven bikini, spun from smart-fiber mesh, clings to my curves, glowing faintly with every pulse of the city's energy grid. It’s not just a suit; it’s a second skin. 

Below me, hover-traffic streams like liquid light. Above, the holographic ads shimmer, projecting dancers that fade into mist. I adjust the strap, feeling the cool breeze dance over my bare shoulders. The heat is rising, not just from the sun’s dying rays, but from the crowd gathering below. They look up, eyes wide, captivated by the woman in the digital sea. 

I catch the gaze of a drone operator in a passing pod. His eyes lock with mine as he slows his vessel, hovering just meters away. I don’t look away. Instead, I tilt my head, letting a stray drop of neon-lit rain trace the line of my neck. His fingers twitch over the controls, drawn to me by an invisible current. 

The music from the club below throbs through the soles of my feet. I step forward, the hem of my bikini shimmering as it reacts to my body heat. The fabric tightens slightly, accentuating the sway of my hips. I am not just watching the city; I am its pulse. And tonight, I feel alive, raw, and undeniably sexy in this chrome jungle. 🌆✨ Who’s ready to dive in with me?
